paper.textual_conclusion:
Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness
of our approach, as evidenced by achieving a new state-of-the-art
(SOTA) performance on WLASL100 and LSA64. For WLASL100, we
achieve a top-1 accuracy of 86.50%, marking a relative improvement
of 2.39% over the previous SOTA. For LSA64, we achieve a top-1
accuracy of 99.84%.
